index.021:
Oshi Island puts pixel art of your fave in the iPhone's Dynamic Island.
        Scrolling social media, playing a game, whatever you're doing, glance up and there they are.
        An idol, a VTuber, an anime character, or your own pet all work.
index.022: Free to use. iPhone only, iOS 18 or later.
index.023: Make your fave, then put them up top
index.024: Can't draw? A photo is enough to get started.
index.026: Pick a photo and the app removes the background and turns it into dots. You choose how many colors and how fine the grid is. If you want to keep the background, switch off automatic removal.
index.027: Draw dot by dot, animate frame by frame
index.028: Make a blink or a jump with up to 10 frames. Pinching to zoom won't leave stray dots, and you can undo and redo.
index.029: Long-press for a word from your fave
index.030: Long-press the Dynamic Island and your fave appears large, saying the line you set for them.
index.032: Keep as many as you like and switch who's showing whenever you want. You can also send your animations to friends with AirDrop.
index.035: On the home screen, tap From Photo to pick a photo, or Create New to start drawing.
index.036: Set it in the Dynamic Island
index.037: Tap the fave you want and choose Set as Dynamic Island. You can set their line when you make them, or later with Edit Name & Dialogue in the editor.
index.039: Then just use your iPhone as usual. Your fave is up top. To stop, tap End in the app.
index.040: What's free, and what the plan adds
index.043: There's a weekly plan that renews every week and a one-time purchase you pay for once. For prices, the purchase screen in the app and the App Store show the current amounts.

index.045: More answers are on the FAQ page.

faq.060: Frequently asked questions about Oshi Island. What to do when your fave disappears or the animation stops, how to stop the display, and how to restore or cancel purchases.
faq.064: My fave disappears after a while
faq.065: iOS stops a Dynamic Island display after about 8 hours at most from when it starts. That's the same for every app, and apps can't extend it.
faq.066: From version 1.4.1, opening the app brings back the same fave and line you had before. If your fave is gone, just open the app once.
faq.067: My fave goes missing while I'm using other apps
faq.068: Other apps use the Dynamic Island too, for things like music playback, timers, or arrival updates. When several are running, iOS decides which one gets the large spot, so your fave may shrink or be hidden. It comes back once the other app's display ends.
faq.069: I swiped my fave away on the Lock Screen and now it's gone
faq.070: Swiping your fave away on the Lock Screen also ends the Dynamic Island display. Open the app and the same fave comes back. The same goes for after restarting your iPhone.
faq.071: The animation stops and turns into a still image
faq.072: Up to version 1.4.0 there was a bug where, after going back into the app once, the animation would stop playing. It's fixed in 1.4.1. Update the app from the App Store, then set your fave in the Dynamic Island again.
faq.073: I want to stop the display, or turn it off for a while
faq.074: On the app's home screen, tap End on the Dynamic Island Active bar at the top. You can also long-press the Dynamic Island to expand it and tap the × in the top right.
faq.075: A fave you ended yourself won't come back on its own when you open the app. To show it again, tap your fave and choose Set as Dynamic Island.
faq.076: I want to switch to a different fave
faq.077: On the home screen, tap another fave and choose Set as Dynamic Island to swap. If you delete the fave that's currently showing, it's taken down from the Dynamic Island as well.
faq.078: It says "Live Activities are turned off" and I can't show my fave
faq.079: Live Activities for Oshi Island are switched off in your iPhone's settings. Open the Settings app, find Oshi Island in the list of apps, and turn on Live Activities. You can also get there with the Settings button in the message the app shows.
faq.080: Does it work on iPhones without a Dynamic Island?
faq.081: Yes. On those iPhones, your fave shows on the Lock Screen. The app is for iPhone only and needs iOS 18 or later. iPad isn't supported.
faq.083: When I make art from a photo, hair or parts of the body get removed
faq.084: On the photo screen, switch off Remove Background Automatically and the whole photo is turned into dots as is. Images that already have a transparent background are used as they are, without automatic removal.
faq.085: Pinching to zoom with two fingers leaves dots or lines
faq.086: Fixed in 1.4.1. As soon as a second finger touches the screen, that stroke is undone. To move the canvas around while zoomed in, choose the hand button and you can pan without drawing.
faq.087: I want to undo a mistake
faq.088: Use the undo and redo buttons on the drawing screen. They were added in 1.4.1, so if you don't see them, update the app.
faq.089: I can't tell erased squares from squares painted white
faq.090: From 1.4.1, empty transparent squares are shown with a gray and white checkerboard. Squares painted white look solid white.
faq.091: When I play the animation, my latest drawing goes back to an older one
faq.092: Up to 1.4.0, strokes sometimes weren't saved to the frame before playback. From 1.4.1, each stroke is saved to its frame as soon as you lift your finger.
faq.093: Can I send my animations to friends?
faq.094: Yes. On the home screen, tap your fave and choose Share with Friends to send it with AirDrop or similar. It's added to the other person's Oshi Island.
faq.096: I paid, but I still see ads
faq.097: Up to 1.4.0, an ad could be shown before the app had finished loading your purchase status. In 1.4.1 the app checks your purchase status again right before showing an ad. If ads still appear after updating, tap Restore Purchases in Settings. If they keep appearing after that, please let me know through the contact page.
faq.098: My purchase is gone after switching phones or reinstalling
faq.099: Open Settings with the gear in the top right of the app and tap Restore Purchases. You need to be signed in with the same Apple Account you used to buy.
faq.100: How do I cancel the weekly plan?
faq.101: You cancel in your iPhone's Settings app. Tap your name at the top, open Subscriptions, choose Oshi Island, and tap Cancel Subscription. Deleting the app does not cancel it.
faq.103: Refunds for App Store purchases are handled by Apple, and I can't process them as the developer. You can request one at reportaproblem.apple.com.
faq.104: Do the weekly plan and the one-time purchase unlock different features?
faq.105: No, they're the same. Both let you make as many animations as you like, use every grid size and the special motion effects for photo art, and remove ads. The only difference is how you pay.
faq.108: Only on your iPhone. Nothing is sent to a server. If you delete the app, the faves you made are deleted too. See the Privacy Policy for details.
faq.109: Can I move my faves to a new iPhone?
faq.110: There's no automatic transfer. On your old iPhone, send each fave with Share with Friends to the new iPhone over AirDrop, and it will be imported there.
faq.112: Send me your iPhone model, iOS version, app version, and what you did and what happened, through the contact page. You can find the app version under Version in Settings.

The only information that leaves your device is what's needed to show ads (Google AdMob) and to manage purchases (RevenueCat). The Japanese version of this policy is the authoritative one.
